title: This is an excellent service
text:
This is an excellent service.  

We have two large and ferocious German Shephards.  That's a combined 200 lbs. of solid muscle, strong determination, and unmatched smarts that have been bred to fight a threat.  Don't get me wrong here, these guys are sweethearts, well-trained, and unshakably loyal.  

Unfortunately, for these guys, the vet poses a threat.  So it is a conflict of interest in their minds.  They know they must comply, and they do, but they also feel threatened.  This conflict turns the "fight instinct" into fear.  The stress is enormous.

With Dutch, that problem is eliminated.  The dogs feel quite comfortable coming into my home office, because this is usually the first stop before we take a walk.  It is a happy time for them.  We talk with the doctor, use the webcam to let the doc take a look, and we are done.  Meds are at our door shortly after.

If you want an easier way to do the vet, this is it.  Save time and money while reducing hassle and, most importantly, stress on your dog.
